name: MKesar Indian Interest Pro
author: mkesarkumar

sections.description:
MKesar Indian Interest Pro is a simple and easy-to-use interest calculator designed for Indian users. It supports Indian number formatting (Lakhs/Crores) and displays results in Indian Rupees (₹).

Features:
* Indian Rupee (₹) currency support.
* Simple Interest calculation (PRT/100).
* Professional Glassmorphism Design.
* Shortcode support: [mkesar_calc]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mkesar-calculator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode [mkesar_calc] in any page or post.
